name: OKC_ASYNC_UPLOAD_CONTRACT_H
description: This table stores the details of the all the contract terms documents uploaded in the background.

columns.name: ASYNC_UPLOAD_CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier. Primary key column of the table.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Business document header ID. Foreign key to various business document header tables.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_VERSION
columns.description: Business document version.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Business document type. Foreign key to OKC_BUS_DOC_TYPES_B.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Business document number for which the contract terms document is uploaded.

columns.name: DOC_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the source type of the uploaded document.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the uploaded document.

columns.name: FILE_WML_NO_REDLINE
columns.description: Contents of the uploaded document without mark ups.

columns.name: FILE_WML_REDLINE
columns.description: Contents of the uploaded document with mark ups.

columns.name: FILE_TITLE
columns.description: Title of the uploaded document.

columns.name: FILE_DECSRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the uploaded document.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UPLOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the uploaded document.

columns.name: UPLOAD_USER_GUID
columns.description: GUID of the uploaded user.

columns.name: UPLOAD_USER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the uploaded user.

columns.name: UPLOAD_FROM_WORD_YN
columns.description: Indicates if the upload is from Word add-in.

columns.name: TERMS_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the terms template ID.

columns.name: REVIEW_YN
columns.description: Indicates if the document changes will be reviewed by user.

columns.name: AUTO_CLOSE_COLLABORATION_YN
columns.description: Indicates if the collaboration has to close  automatically.

columns.name: JOB_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the job completion.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
